descriptionChirho: The proper noun 'Asa'el (meaning 'God has made') refers to several individuals in the Hebrew Bible, most notably the brother of Joab and nephew of David. All four clusters represent the same personal name with variation due to conjunctive waw, and notably S126537/S126538 appear to be split-word artifacts where 'Asah-El' was divided at the hyphen. Multilingual glosses confirm unity: Spanish 'Asahel/Asael/Asa-El', Hindi 'Asahel', Arabic 'Asa'iyl', Korean 'Asahel', and Swahili 'Asaheli'. S126538 with 'El' alone is the second half of the compound name, not a separate referent.
